about.title: About Me
about.description: I'm a full-stack web developer who specializes in building responsive and modern web applications using React.js, Next.js, and Node.js. I have hands-on experience with REST API integration, scalable deployments, and collaborative projects. I enjoy solving real-world problems with clean code and practical design.

project0.title: Fashion E-commerce
project0.description: A modern fashion e-commerce application with product catalog, shopping cart, user authentication, and responsive design for a seamless online shopping experience.

project1.title: Perfumes App
project1.description: Is a modern web application designed to explore and showcase a collection of perfumes with a clean, responsive interface.

project2.title: Personal Website
project2.description: This is my personal portfolio where I share everything I've worked on, designed with a cozy Studio Ghibli-inspired look. It's built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui, and supports both English and Indonesian using Next Intl.

project3.title: Expert System
project3.description: A full-stack application implementing the Certainty Factor method for decision-making. Built with Express.js and MySQL on the backend, and React.js with Tailwind CSS on the frontend.
